name: Snap
description: The first clip spans the frame like a plank held at its sides: it sags in the middle under its own weight, a jagged crack runs up from the bottom, and the two halves snap apart, swing down around their outer top corners and drop out of the frame, revealing the second clip under their shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: sag
params.description: How far the middle sags before it cracks, relative to the frame height

params.name: jaggedness
params.description: Sideways jitter of the jagged crack

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the shadow cast on the second clip (alpha: strength)
